liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (6 reviews): Listener says Playin' In The Band runs about 47 minutes; Playin' fills a whole cassette side; the jam climbs through several highly dissonant crescendos, testing listeners who dislike atonality [15][16][17][20][23][25]
- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (1 review): Jerry sings a great version of Roses, according to the reviewer [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer praises Jerry's Scarlet Begonias as a great version [17]
- **Money Money** (1 review): Listener flags Money Money as a rare song in this show's highlights [15]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer vividly remembers Let It Grow from the show, and also the Wall of Sound [26]
- **Big River** (1 review): The track labeled Around & Around is really Big River; this copy also lacks Stella Blue and Around [21]

## Setlist highlights

- **Money Money**: rare: 7 archived performances [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-21.sbd.matrix.tobin.87114.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 198 min; rated 4.55/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd-patched.wier.22801.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 197 min; rated 4.11/5 by 18 [2]. Said about its sound: This source is only worth having for Stella Blue and Around & Around; the other soundboard sounds much better; This copy has a little noise but sounds dynamic and thrilling [22][24]
- **gd1974-05-21.aud-fixed.tobin.87143.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 25 songs; 198 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [4]
- **gd1974-05-21.150950.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd.belkin.2597.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 183 min; rated 4.52/5 by 23 [9]. Said about its sound: Keith's piano is mixed up unusually well, and audience-recording listeners can hear the crowd cheering near the end of Playin'; Reviewer finds the recording high quality in both musicianship and sound [23][25]

## Around the show

- Reviewer prefers this Playin' to the June 18 Let It Grow into The Other One [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-21.sbd.matrix.tobin.87114.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [1]. Also: Recorded by Pat Lee on Sony ECM18N hand-held mics into a Sony 152SD deck, from the right balcony; Transferred by David Minches via Nakamichi Dragon; tracks and editing by Noah Weiner in May 2002; most songs lose their first notes; Playin' has no cassette generation and is patched with 26 seconds of audience tape at the reel flip [1]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd-patched.wier.22801.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charles Wier; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Earlier remastered soundboard, patched with audience material via Charles Wier [2]
- **gd1974-05-21.aud-fixed.tobin.87143.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Sony ECM18N mics > Sony 152SD deck recorded by Pat Lee, hand held mics in right balcony (patched version of shn id 10150 see info file for details) [4]. Also: Transferred by David Minches via Nakamichi Dragon; tracks and editing by Noah Weiner in May 2002; most songs lose their first notes; Playin' has no cassette generation and is patched with 26 seconds of audience tape at the reel flip [4]
- **gd1974-05-21.150950.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Patt Lee; transferred by Matt Smith, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Pat Lee's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM18N mics (hand held, right balcony) > Sony 152SD [7]
- **gd74-05-21.sbd.belkin.2597.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]. Also: Reviewer has long owned this show on a Maxell cassette [16]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1974-05-21 Edmundson Pavilion, U. of Washington, Seattle, WA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1974-05-21-edmundson-pavilion-u-of-washington-seattle-wa-usa/) [28]
- Fan art by blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Pacific Northwest 1973-1974: The Complete Recordings](https://blackmuddyblog.blogspot.com/2018/09/grateful-dead-pacific-northwest-1973.html) [29]
